// dir: x
// want: clean
// with: core
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

type box[Item any] struct{}

func (box[Item]) limit(params core.ParamSet) int { return params.Int("max_lines", 0) }

func run(ctx core.AnalysisContext) {
	var holder box[int]
	_ = holder.limit(ctx.Params("file-size"))
}
